name: Khandaker Mushtaq Ahmed
role: Awami League politician; wartime and post-independence cabinet figure; President after 15 August 1975
contribution: Khandaker Mushtaq Ahmed was active in Awami League politics during the Pakistan period and served in the 1971 wartime provisional-government context and in post-independence cabinet roles.
context: After 15 August 1975, he became President during a rapid power transition marked by disputes over constitutional legitimacy, including the promulgation of the Indemnity Ordinance and subsequent restructuring of post-1975 politics.
impact: His historical legacy remains contested and sensitive in Bangladesh: he is discussed in relation to wartime political leadership, post-independence state formation, and the legitimacy crisis that followed the 1975 transition.
